facts.statement: A daily treasure can be collected at the top of the Snowhill Playground for players who jump well enough to reach it.
facts.quote: you can try to make it all the way to the top where you can collect a daily treasure

article_summaries.title: Explore the Snowhill Playground
article_summaries.summary: An official freerealms.com 'What is New?' news post (captured 2010-07-28) describing a player-built playground in Snowhill made from house-decoration blocks and moving platforms. It says launchpads are needed to reach lower levels, and a daily treasure can be collected at the top, which is reached through disappearing blocks. The post gives no exact date; it says only 'Posted 4 days, 7 hours ago'.
